verdict.rationale: Riskified is a fraud-prevention SaaS, so a natural-language operating interface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, documents only REST endpoints, SDKs, Beacon snippets, platform plugins and an Integration Console, with no conversational or natural-language way to operate the product. The llms.txt probe only makes documentation readable by LLMs; it is not a natural-language control surface, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
